title: A Volcano Erupted for Months and Killed a Fifth of Iceland

scenes.text: A volcano erupted for months and killed a fifth of Iceland.
In 1783, the Laki eruption poured lava over about 220 square miles.
Its gases poisoned the grass, and most of Iceland's animals died.
The famine that followed killed about one in five people.
A haze drifted over most of Europe, and even reached Syria.
One crack in the ground, and a continent under haze.

description:
A volcano erupted for months and killed a fifth of Iceland.
The 1783 Laki eruption poisoned the land, and its haze drifted over most of Europe.
Had you heard of Laki?
first_comment: One volcano hazed a whole continent. What other eruption should we cover next?
